deletionTitle: This workspace is scheduled for deletion
deletionDetail: Every app, keyword and history in it is erased on or after {date}. The owner can cancel it until then.
breakageDetail: This is on us, not your setup. Your stored data is untouched and collection resumes on its own once we ship a fix. Until then, collection is paused for {stores}.
delayStoresTitle: Rankings for your {stores} apps are delayed
delayEmptyDetail: Today's run has not captured anything yet. Your stored history is unchanged, and collection resumes on its own.
delayProgressDetail: Today's run has captured {captured} of {tracked} tracked keywords. Positions you see may be from yesterday until it finishes.
